description: Just Publish puts websites online. You build the page in ChatGPT - a landing page, a portfolio, a one-page site for your business - and Just Publish makes it live at a shareable URL, right from the conversation. ChatGPT sends the static files (HTML, CSS, JS, images) and gets back a working link anyone can open, with no build step and no command line. You sign in once, and every site you publish is saved to your account: change a headline, update a page, or add a new one, and see it live right away. It's for anyone who built a page with AI and just wants it online.
